talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $293.7M sold across 9 Form D filings this week, up 134% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Ajc Savannah Gs Holding LLC (Bloomfield Hills, Other Real Estate) targeting $8.7M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
INVMW Delray Senior Investor LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan real estate assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

5 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $277.9M raised so far — led by TRP Capital Partners VI, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
